needed.evidence: No footway on the left side of the road, people must walk in the roadway.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The right side footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles and other obstructions.
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure the right side footway is clear and accessible for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the right side footway pose trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Repair and resurface the right side footway to eliminate trip hazards and ensure a smooth walking surface.

needed.evidence: There is a demand for crossing due to shops and homes on both sides, but no crossing facility is present.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this location to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The street lighting is inadequate, especially in the urban area.
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for both pedestrians and drivers.
